findings.message: reads a workflow's text itself: it drifts from what the CI model says the workflow means
findings.fix: Ask the CI model instead of reading the file: `./dev gates model` (tools/paddock-dev/src/gates/ci.rs), or `Ctx::workflows()` in a check. A site that has to stay is listed in conformance/c158-allow.json (path, site, reason, count), which the user approves.
